Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Chi: Noboru pushes him to a new path. While you have at least one unit in your current army, the target's Force contributes to that army's total Force instead of his controller's.
title: Togashi Noboru

designernotes: Boxable support for RAs
flavor: "The Crane? What are they but a band of spoiled children? We will drive them from the Colonies with little effort."

text:
(The Defender may draw a card after a Brash card is assigned to attack.)
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
title: Tsuruchi Kohrogi

designernotes: The Ruby Champion is a Sensei.  I think since we have a mechanic for that, we should use it.  This Mantis Sensei is for Economic Warfare.
flavor: "No the most promising class I have ever seen, but I will turn them into magistrates regardless."

text:
After Nobukatsu enters play or overlays: Discard all your other Sensei Personalities.
Your Mantis Clan Samurai in and out of play have Magistrate.
Battle: Target a Personality at any location: Bow him.
title: Tsuruchi Nobukatsu

designernotes: [Son of Satsu] turning away from a pilgrim.
flavor: "What did you seek here?"

text:
As a Focus Effect: You may discard your Personality in this duel (ending the duel without resolution).
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Monk at any location and bow your target Ring: Give the current battlefield's province +3 or -3 strength.
title: Turning Away

designernotes: [Art Note: A courtier heralds the exploits of an honorable warrior of his clan, only to have a Scorpion courtier slander the warrior, undoing any benefits.]
flavor: "Yes, the story of your cousin's battle is quite entertaining," Bayushi Shibata said. "Equally entertaining is the story of what he was doing in that district at the time. Allow me to tell it."

text: Reaction: Before a Proclaim action resolves: Negate its effects.
title: Turning the Story

designernotes: Now you can put weapons with useful abilitieis on Kensai with useful abilities
flavor: He was the first to draw his sword, but he was not the last.

text: Battle: Choose your performing Kensai: You may take two additional Battle actions from cards in his unit. Other actions will not give you new additional Battle actions this battle.
title: Two Hands

designernotes: A Tsuruchi archer shooting two arrows in close succession.
flavor: A Wasp never strikes a single time.

text:
Battle: Bow your performing Personality or Follower: Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: If this card is in your discard pile, bow your performing Personality or Follower: Ranged 4 Attack. Remove this card from the game.
title: Two Stings

designernotes: A shoddy wall.
flavor: "Spend little time on the plan, for the only thing that is certain is that everything will go wrong." - Tangen's Lies

text: Battle: Target an enemy Personality or Follower: Give it -4F.
title: Unexpected Obstacle

designernotes: A sword that improves the wielder's skill.
flavor: Its blade was compared by many to a sliver of Emma-O himself. Surely even the Fortune of Death could not be more dangerous.

text:
This Personality has Kensai.
Battle: Melee 4 Attack.
title: Unparalleled Sword

designernotes: Monks arguing about Fudoism.
flavor: Hesitation, particularly when justified, can be disastrous.

text:
Open: Target a Ring which did not last enter play by its own text: This is not true enlightenment. Permanently remove its abilities.
Limited: Target one or more cards in your provinces: Discard them. Refill the provinces face-up from the bottom of your deck.
title: Unsettling Doubts

designernotes: [Art Note: A Courtier is desperately trying to stall while a Courtier from a military clan is doing everything he can to end this court session so he can attack.]
flavor: The clamor rose as everyone strove to be heard first.

text:
Open: Each player may only take two more non-Reaction actions this phase.
Limited: Pay 2 Gold: Draw a card.
title: Urgency

designernotes: [Art Note: A Battle maiden who focus more on the honor side of things.]
flavor: In her meditations, she saw tranquil formations.

text:
Your dishonorable Battle Maidens do not have a maximum Personal Honor of 0 from the rulebook.
Limited: Gain 2 Honor. You may not declare an attack this turn.
title: Utaku Chikako

designernotes: [Art Note: This is the beleaguered male Utaku stable master that Story requested.]
flavor: It was rarely a good sign when a horse laid down.

text: Open: Bow Hirononri and target a Stables or Cavalry card: Straighten it.
title: Utaku Hirononri

designernotes: Chi often has little to do in the draft environment; thought I'd give those lowF/highC guys something to do in a fight.
flavor: "Now it is the Mantis who have no time for your foolishness, old man. Did you think we had forgotten your insult?"

text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy Personality with lower Chi: Move him home.
title: Vengeful Dismissal

designernotes: [Art Note: An Utaku Battle Maiden and a Matsu paragon come across some starving peasants who are in desperate need of koku to survive. Gee, I wonder which one will donate more money. ;)]
flavor: Charity and virtue are often one.

text: Open: If it is not your turn, choose another player: You come across some starving peasants in need. You, then the player, each pay zero or more Gold. Whoever paid more Gold gains Honor equal to the difference between the two amounts paid, or 4, whichever is less.
title: Virtuous Charity

designernotes: [Art Note: A Ninja who can move around constantly so you never know whom he is attached to.]
flavor: Many students of shinobi dojo take odd, esoteric names. They believe it grants them power.

text: Will only attach to a Ninja.
title: Water Spider Adept

designernotes: Grabbed from August Random ideas
flavor: "The valley has been the sight of a hundred battles over a thousand years, but somehow it always endures. It is beyond destruction." - Hida Kisada

text:
Before an action's effect destroys a card in a unit: Negate the destruction.
Battle: If there is no Terrain in play at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.
title: Wide Valley

designernotes: An older Yasuki merchant, who's often called upon to give advice to the young.
flavor: Throughout the Colonies, the words of Fudo reached the ears of Crab warriors. And many found the words pleasing indeed…

text:
Favor Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor to target a dishonorable Personality. His controller loses 1 Honor.
Political Open, :g2:: Take the Imperial Favor.
title: Yasuki Baiko

designernotes: Yasuki Tsujiken experienced, is now favored by the Void Dragon
flavor: "I can get you what you need, my friend. There is just one question I must ask…"

story: 2011 Favored of the Void Dragon - Robyn Pavlakovich
text:
Open: Target a Holding or your Stronghold: Bow or straighten it.
Limited: Pay 5 Gold: Draw a card.
Limited: Bow Tsujiken and target a Personality: Dishonor him. His controller loses 1 Honor.
title: Yasuki Tsujiken

designernotes: A Yogo Yojimbo that thinks she isn't affected by the Yogo curse putting her charge in harm's way to trap the enemy.
flavor: Some Yogo seek to defeat their curse through their own deaths. But even death can be a betrayal.

text: Battle: Target your Courtier and an enemy Personality: Move them to the current battlefield. Straighten the enemy Personality's unit.
title: Yogo Heijin

designernotes: A Scorpion Shugenja.
flavor: "There is a temple in the jungles that the Spider did not report. Go and find it." - Bayushi Shibata

text: Reaction: After Ugimori enters play from a province, choose a player: He may not take the Proclaim action until your next turn begins.
title: Yogo Ugimori

designernotes: Uses a weaving and rolling Mantis combat style
flavor:
"You have served long as a mercenary," Hiromi said. "Have you forgotten what it is like to serve your clan?"
"Never, my lord," Akukiho replied. "All I have done is kept myself sharp for the day you needed me."

text: Battle: Target a Weapon in your hand: Attach it to Akukiho, paying all costs. You may take an additional Battle action.
title: Yoritomo Akukiho

designernotes: Brash Magistrate
flavor: "Now things will get interesting. We have many advantages, but we must push them to their limit if we are to defeat the Crane and claim their holdings."

text: Limited: If Iwashi has been in an attacking army when it won a battle since your last turn began, target a Personality: Bow him.
title: Yoritomo Iwashi

text:
May not be included in decks.
This card has the title and base Gold Cost of the Personality who performed Akuma's Power's action.
title: Your Name is Mine

designernotes: A generic Sensei, set honor req to keep out of Spider decks, but he is available for all other EE Commander builds.
flavor: "Come talk with me, and I will tell you how to be a leader of men."

text:
After Zansho enters play: Discard all your other Sensei Personalities.
Your Followers have +1F or a Force bonus equal to their Honor Requirement, whichever is greater.
title: Zansho
